description: This file contains the PHP class definition for the Opencart Admin Module setting model, including methods for adding, editing, deleting, and retrieving module configurations.

classes.name: Module
classes.description: PHP class for managing module settings within the OpenCart admin area, including CRUD operations.

methods.name: addModule
methods.description: Adds a new module to the database with provided code and data.

methods.name: editModule
methods.description: Updates an existing module's information in the database based on its ID.

methods.name: deleteModule
methods.description: Deletes a module from the database given its ID.

methods.name: deleteModulesByCode
methods.description: Deletes all modules associated with a specific code.

methods.name: getModule
methods.description: Retrieves a module's settings by its ID, returning the decoded JSON data.

methods.name: getModules
methods.description: Retrieves all modules, ordered by their code.

methods.name: getModulesByCode
methods.description: Retrieves modules matching a specific code, ordered by name.
